template_meta.name: Split_Panel_Problem_Solution_Card
template_meta.description: A two-panel problem/solution comparison ad on a soft pastel background — a photographic 'problem' image on the left and a floating product studio shot on the right, joined by a plus-sign divider, under bold underlined 'If you have THIS / Use THIS' headlines.

user_inputs.problem_image_description: a close-up photo of a concrete roof tile heavily covered in green moss and black mould stains, weathered and neglected, shot in natural daylight

sections.rendering_note: Composited as real text using {user_inputs.headline_font_path} — the image model cannot embed a literal brand font, only approximate a style, so headline text is painted on top of the generated background/panels in a separate pass. See template_meta.production_note.

rendering.lighting: soft diffused studio, key light top-left

generative_image_prompt: A 1080x1350px (4:5) vertical ad on a solid brand background ({user_inputs.background_color_hex}, flat, no gradient or tinting). Top-left corner: a white rounded card (square top-left corner, rounded bottom-right corner) covering roughly the top 8% and left 55% of the canvas, containing the {user_inputs.brand_name} wordmark logo from the supplied logo reference image, reproduced unaltered, left-aligned with small padding. Below that, starting around 29% down and spanning to about 71% down the canvas, two side-by-side panels with rounded top corners and square bottom corners: the LEFT panel is a photorealistic, slightly desaturated close-up photo of {user_inputs.problem_image_description} — filling the panel edge-to-edge. The RIGHT panel is a white card containing a photorealistic studio product shot of {user_inputs.product_name} (from the supplied product reference image), centred, with soft studio lighting and a soft contact shadow beneath it. Between the two panels, vertically centred on the row, a small bold white plus (+) sign sits on the background, overlapping both panel edges slightly. Leave the band above the panels (roughly 18%-28% down the canvas) empty/background-only — headline text is NOT generated by the image model. Output: 1080x1350px, 4:5 aspect ratio, RGB, clean commercial ad-photography style, no text.
production_note: Two-pass hybrid build, required whenever a client mandates a specific brand typeface: (1) generate the logo card, photo panel, product panel, and plus-sign divider with generative_image_prompt via peelgen.py/Gemini — leave the headline band empty; (2) composite the real headline text on top with PIL using the brand's actual font file ({user_inputs.headline_font_path}), centred over each panel below it. Diffusion image models can only approximate a typeface from a text description (e.g. 'heavy grotesk sans-serif') — they cannot embed a literal font file, so prompt-only attempts will never exactly match a specific commercial typeface. Compositing is the only reliable fix. Learned on the Wet & Forget build, 2026-08-03 — see wiki/clients/wet-and-forget/brief.md Creative Notes.
